set.body:
`robust` is consulted before `robust_psi` and defaults to FALSE (not NULL), so
robust_options$type is always occupied before the robust_psi branch is reached.
Its guard `!("type" %in% names(robust_options))` is therefore always false.

Verified:
  robust=FALSE (default), robust_psi="bisquare"  -> type = FALSE
  robust=TRUE,            robust_psi="bisquare"  -> type = "huber"
  robust=NULL,            robust_psi="bisquare"  -> type = "bisquare"

So the argument has zero observable effect anywhere in the repo. Documented at
R/fmrilm.R:535 as "Shorthand for robust_options$type".

Site: .fmri_lm_normalize_robust_options, R/fmrilm.R:254-284 (guards at :270, :273).

Existing coverage is vacuous: tests/testthat/test_robust_args.R:18-23 passes
robust=TRUE, robust_psi="bisquare" and asserts only expect_error(..., NA), which
passes whether or not the psi choice is honoured.
set.title: Fix: robust_psi is structurally unreachable
